mapper.sql: select c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_user_id, cast(c.content as char) as content, c.images, c.is_anonymous, c.like_count, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, case when c.is_anonymous = '1' then '匿名用户' else c.nick_name end as nick_name, case when c.is_anonymous = '1' then '' else c.avatar end as avatar, case when c.is_anonymous = '1' then '' else p.nick_name end as reply_nick_name, case when c.is_anonymous = '1' then '' else c.dept_name end as dept_name, case when c.is_anonymous = '1' then 0 when p.response_dept_id is not null and dc.contact_user_id = c.user_id and dc.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end as is_official_reply from bbs_comment c left join bbs_post p on c.post_id = p.post_id left join bbs_dept_contact dc on p.response_dept_id = dc.dept_id and dc.status = '0'
mapper.select: where c.user_id = #{hashCode} and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.update_time desc

SELECT post.post_id as postId, post.title, `comment`.comment_id as commentId, `comment`.user_id as commentUserId, `comment`.nick_name as commentNickName, `comment`.content as commentContent, `comment`.status as commentStatus, `comment`.del_flag as commentDelFlag, `comment`.create_time as createTime FROM bbs_comment `comment` LEFT JOIN bbs_post post ON post.post_id = `comment`.post_id WHERE post.del_flag='0' AND `comment`.comment_id IS NOT NULL
AND post.content like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
AND `comment`.content like concat('%', #{commentContent}, '%')
ORDER BY `comment`.create_time DESC
